[Fetch and read the web] URL to Markdown web scraper for agents and RAG: read any public web page as clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Fetch one public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown: navigation, cookie banners, footers, share bars and related-post blocks removed; headings, nested lists, links, images with alt, tables as pipe tables and code as fenced blocks with language. Plus title, description, lang, canonical, published/modified date when the page states one, word count and token estimate. Options: include_links=false (text only), max_tokens=100-100000 (cut at block boundaries, truncated flag). Up to 60,000 characters. Obeys robots.txt. ~1-3 s.

include_links.description: false = drop link targets and images, keep the text (default true)

max_tokens.description: Cut the Markdown to about this many tokens at block boundaries (100-100000); sets truncated and truncated_reason "max_tokens"

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com
